description: Source code for a PHP class that implements a config file parser for Smarty templating engine, including lexical analysis, parsing rules, and handling of config variables and sections.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Configfileparser
classes.description: Internal class for parsing Smarty config files, generated from a parsing grammar, handling tokenization, syntax analysis, and variable management.

classes.name: TPC_yyStackEntry
classes.description: Helper class representing a stack entry in the parser stack, holding the state number, major token, and minor token value.

methods.name: doParse
methods.description: Main method to process input tokens and perform parsing according to the grammar rules.

methods.name: parse_bool
methods.description: Helper method to interpret string tokens as boolean true/false.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the target array, respecting overwrite rules.

methods.name: add_global_vars
methods.description: Adds parsed variables to the global configuration data.

methods.name: add_section_vars
methods.description: Adds parsed variables to a specific section in the configuration data.

methods.name: yy_shift
methods.description: Performs a shift action in the parser, pushing a new state and token onto the stack.

methods.name: yy_reduce
methods.description: Performs a reduce action based on a grammar rule, collapsing stack entries into a higher-level node.

methods.name: yy_accept
methods.description: Handles successful parsing state, finalizing the parse process.

methods.name: yy_parse_failed
methods.description: Handles parse failure by cleaning up the parser stack.

methods.name: yy_syntax_error
methods.description: Handles syntax errors detected during parsing.
